entries.easy_read:
I start my message.
I say hello politely.

entries.text: I am writing to ask about my shift timing.
entries.easy_read:
I say why I write.
I want to ask about my hours.

I send a file with my message.
I tell you it is there.

I end my message.
I write my name.

entries.text: Thank you for your message. I will do it today.
entries.easy_read:
I got your message.
I will do the work today.

entries.text: May I know by when you need this?
entries.easy_read: I ask when it must be done.

entries.text: I am sorry for the delay in replying.
entries.easy_read:
I answered late.
I say sorry.

entries.text: I would like to request leave on Friday, the tenth.
entries.easy_read:
I write to ask for a day off.
The day is Friday.

entries.text: I am following up on my message from Monday.
entries.easy_read:
I wrote to you on Monday.
I did not get an answer.
I write again.

entries.text: Quick update: all orders for today are packed.
entries.easy_read:
I send a short message.
All the work is done.

entries.text: Could you clarify point two, please?
entries.easy_read:
I do not understand part two.
Please explain it.

entries.text: I have copied my supervisor on this message.
entries.easy_read:
My boss can see this message too.
I tell you so you know.

entries.text: Could you send this as plain text? It works better with my screen reader.
entries.easy_read:
Pictures of words do not work for me.
Please send simple text.
Then my computer can read it.

entries.text: I confirm I have received the documents.
entries.easy_read:
Your papers came to me.
I tell you they arrived.

entries.text: This is a gentle reminder about the pending approval.
entries.easy_read:
I still need your yes.
I ask again in a kind way.
